speaker: Ash
text: Emberwing! Form up — today the whole academy watches us burn bright.

speaker: Serra
text: Watch your footing, Ash. Tidemark holds the fort, and the tide does not part for sparks.

speaker: Corin
text: Do carry on, both of you. Thornrook finds it terribly instructive when rivals blunt each other's blades for free.

speaker: Ash
text: Blunt THIS, Corin— ahem. Emberwing, eyes northeast: Serra holds the fort on the hill.

speaker: Brenna
text: Then the orders are simple. Reach Lady Serra and defeat her — or rout every Tidemark student on the field.

speaker: Wren
text: And it's a mock battle — nobody dies today. Yield if you must; I'll patch everything else.

speaker: Ash
text: Fight close. Fight as one house. Emberwing — advance!
